messages:
alex: Heads up: we27re seeing a small but steady uptick in tokenization errors for rtv routes after the midnight deploy. It27s tied to v4.7.0 tokenizer thresholds. I pushed a hotfix image `redwood/token:4.7.1-hotfix` that tightens the fallback and reverts an aggressive chunking heuristic. Change window ends in 35m — requesting expedited deploy. @oncall-sre @meera

oncall-sre: Share quick verification steps + rollback criteria and I can sign off. Need auto-rollback in place for safety.

meera: Paste image sha and smoke commands please. Also confirm there27s no state migration.

alex: sha=`789abce9`. No migrations. Smoke: `curl -sS http://tokenizer.svc/health` then `./infra/loadgen.py --route rtv --qps 100 --duration 60 --sample 200`. Ran it against staging, errors decreased.

ops-bot: Expedited approval requested by alex. React with :thumbsup: from 2 leads within 12m to proceed.

tony: :thumbsup: (ops)

jules: :thumbsup: (eng)

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Received command: `/deploy start --service=tokenizer --image=redwood/token:4.7.1-hotfix --canary=5% --notes="hotfix revert aggressive chunking"`

deploy-bot: Canary deployed (5% traffic). Metrics link: https://deploy.metrics/canary/7150004321. Initial errors 0.04% vs baseline 0.12%, p95 latency -8ms.

meera: Running quicktrace checks on canary. Will follow for 3m and post results. Please ensure we have rollback thresholds: errors > 0.5% absolute OR tokenization-failure-rate increase > 0.3% for 2 consecutive minutes.

oncall-sre: Those rollback thresholds look good. I'll leave auto-rollback enabled.

jules: Canary traces look clean, fewer retry loops observed.

deploy-bot: Promoting canary to 50% on operator command...

deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% complete. Observability dashboard: steady.

alex: Plan to wait 5m then promote to 100% if steady. Pinning image until EOD.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 100% per alex approval...

deploy-bot: Swap complete 100% traffic -> image `redwood/token:4.7.1-hotfix`. Rollback command: `/deploy rollback --to=redwood/token:4.7.0 --ticket=HOTFIX-9512`

ops-bot: Note: please add a short release note to the changelog PR with the rollback command and ticket.

alex: Changelog PR: https://git.host/release-notes/pull/1210  note: "Revert aggressive chunking heuristic to reduce tokenization failures on rtv routes (4.7.1)."

meera: Observability steady after full swap. No regressions. Closing expedited window. I'll schedule a short postmortem if the original regression recurs.

oncall-sre: Affirming all good. Keep canary logs pinned for 30m for later correlation.

jules: Nice quick cycle, rollback path tested and available :white_check_mark:
